'''Dorin Se'ol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Dorin Se'ol was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Se'ol was a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When the war came to an abrupt end as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], betrayed the Order and dissolved the Republic, Master Se'ol fled execution by the Grand Army to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and took refuge on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]<ref name="TUR" />

On Volik, Master Se'ol assisted the colonists he found there rebuild their homes that had been destroyed in recent time by groups of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. During his exile there, Master Se'ol began a relationship with a woman called [[Vorena]], whom he later married and produced a child with, whom they named [[Jolee]]. While Master Se'ol had been loyal to the Order, he had had many disagreements with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Despite this, Master Se'ol began training all of the Force-sensitives he could gather, guiding them as they grew in the Force and helping them control their emotions. Despite his training however, Master Se'ol was brought dangerously close to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] when his wife, Vorena, died.<ref name="TUR" />

Despite his loss, Master Se'ol remained in the light and did not succumb to grief; instead he realized that through confronting the dark side, he came to further understand the Force and grow. Despite Master Se'ol's attempts to remain inconspicuous in the Unknown Regions, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-controlled [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to Volik in search of the Jedi. Led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], an Imperial assault team attacked Volik and found Se'ol's compound. Confronting Vader, Master Se'ol was able to distract the Sith long enough for his students to escape. While Se'ol was cut down by the Sith Lord, his students escaped with his [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], which would survive the collapse of the Empire and be discovered by the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Jedi Order]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TUR" />
